events.title: "This Moment: Highlights from the White Rabbit Collection" Exhibition
events.description: This exhibition showcases 35 artworks from 25 leading contemporary Chinese artists, offering a powerful snapshot of 21st-century Chinese creativity and culture through large-scale installations, video, photography, painting, and sculpture.

events.title: "Here and Now: Gold Coast Triennial" Exhibition
events.description: This triennial exhibition features 42 artists deeply connected to the Gold Coast, exploring the depth and dynamism of the local creative community through installations, video, sculpture, and 2D works across seven interconnected spaces.

events.title: "Aka Sorbie: Saltwater Heart" Children's Gallery Exhibition
events.description: An immersive exhibition by First Nations artist Lisa Sorbie Martin, bringing her Torres Strait childhood memories to life through bold patterns and ocean-inspired imagery in HOTA's Children's Gallery.

events.title: Aurora MacKrill: "Liza Minnelli – Life is a Cabaret"
events.description: Aurora MacKrill performs a cabaret tribute to Liza Minnelli, presented by the Gold Coast Jazz & Blues Club, offering a live music experience for members and guests.

events.title: HOTA Gallery Public Program: Talks & Workshops
events.description: A recurring program of curator-led tours, artist talks, and hands-on creative workshops tied to current HOTA Gallery exhibitions, offering deeper dives into art and artist stories.

events.title: "Ballun Gawrehma: Story by the River" First Nations Talks & Ideas
events.description: This is a First Nations-focused storytelling and cultural conversation program, offering intimate, community-oriented, and intellectually grounded discussions as part of HOTA's ongoing Talks & Ideas series.

events.title: Architecture Symposium: "Embracing the Value of Time"
events.description: This symposium explores how designing for change, comfort, and reuse can extend the lifespan of interiors, reduce waste, and create relevant spaces for a more sustainable future.

events.title: TableTopCon 2026
events.location: Gold Coast Sports and Leisure Centre, Nerang/Broadbeach
events.description: The ultimate destination for tabletop gaming enthusiasts, offering two days of game demonstrations, opportunities to meet designers and publishers, and connect with like-minded gamers across RPGs, board games, wargames, and card games.

events.title: Sessions Surf Festival Opening Night (Dope Lemon, Babe Rainbow)
events.description: Kicking off a week-long festival of surf, music, film, and art, this opening night features live performances by Dope Lemon, Babe Rainbow, and other bands at Miami Marketta.

events.title: Flotsam Festival — Surf Film & Photography (Final Days)
events.location: Various beachside locations, Burleigh to Coolangatta
events.description: The final week of Gold Coast's surf film and photography festival, featuring indoor and outdoor photo exhibitions, beachside surf cinema nights, and live music, celebrating the region's surf culture and coastline.

events.title: NaturallyGC: Great Glossy Count (Citizen Science)
events.description: Participate in a nationwide citizen science initiative to help protect the threatened Glossy Black-Cockatoo, involving free, hands-on activities in various Gold Coast natural environments to connect with and conserve nature.

events.title: Sanctuary Cove International Boat Show (Design & Marine Tech Focus)
events.description: One of the Southern Hemisphere's largest marine events, featuring best-in-class superyachts, fishing boats, and marine technology, offering insights into design and innovation in the boating industry alongside live entertainment.

events.title: HOTA Farmers & Artisan Market
events.description: A vibrant weekly community market supporting local farmers, makers, and artists, offering fresh produce, artisan foods, boutique fashion, handcrafted wares, and live music in the HOTA precinct.
